name: std-objective-board-3d
description: 3D single-hero objective board FRAME: composes hero-nav (units + move budget) + objective-reach (targets) + fx-particles + objective-flow (win/lose) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/targets via config.

schema.name: std-objective-board-3d
schema.description: 3D single-hero objective board FRAME: composes hero-nav (units + move budget) + objective-reach (targets) + fx-particles + objective-flow (win/lose) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/targets via config.

emits.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

events.name: Hero Stepped
events.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board

gridWidth.label: Grid Width
gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)

gridHeight.label: Grid Height
gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + wander bounds

moveBudget.label: Move Budget
moveBudget.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain

units.label: Initial Units
units.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs

emits.description: Pickup particle produced when a target is reached; a fx-particles listener spawns it
Objectives remaining + moves remaining after this step; a round-flow listener decides win/lose

events.name: Burst
events.description: Pickup particle produced when a target is reached; a fx-particles listener spawns it

events.name: Progress
events.description: Objectives remaining + moves remaining after this step; a round-flow listener decides win/lose

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, hero steps onto targets are scored; toggle to freeze

features.label: Features
features.description: Board features — collectible targets (matched by targetType) plus decorations

removeOnReach.label: Remove On Reach
removeOnReach.description: When true the target model is removed once reached (collect); when false it is flagged done and stays (visit/deliver)

targetType.label: Target Type
targetType.description: Feature type counted as a collectible objective

reachRadius.label: Reach Radius
reachRadius.description: Manhattan distance at which a target counts as reached: 0 = step onto the tile (collect), 1 = adjacent (deliver)

fx.label: Initial Fx
fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

decayRate.label: Decay Rate
decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

emits.description: Emitted for parity with round-flow when the round resolves; listeners may react to end-of-round

events.name: Game End
events.description: Emitted for parity with round-flow when the round resolves; listeners may react to end-of-round

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, PROGRESS signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze

emits.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority
Advances neutral NPCs one random step via the hero-nav authority
Resets every mechanic (units/budget, objectives, result) for a new round

events.name: Move
events.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority

events.name: Wander
events.description: Advances neutral NPCs one random step via the hero-nav authority

events.name: Restart
events.description: Resets every mechanic (units/budget, objectives, result) for a new round

assetManifest.label: Asset Manifest
assetManifest.description: Per-role model manifest resolving tile/unit/feature models by terrain/category key.

objectiveLabel.label: Objective Label
objectiveLabel.description: HUD label for the remaining-objective counter.

movementRange.label: Movement Range
movementRange.description: Max manhattan distance the hero may step per move.

extraStats.label: Extra Stats
extraStats.description: Board-specific HUD stats appended after the standard set.

fxPresets.label: Fx Presets
fxPresets.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark.

scoreLabel.label: Score Label
scoreLabel.description: HUD label for the score/progress counter (e.g. Deliveries counting up).

      ]
    }
  }

  trait Collector = Objective.traits.ObjectiveReach -> GameState {
    config {
      running: true
      targetType: "target"
      pointsPerTarget: 1
      removeOnReach: true
    }
  }

  trait FxDecay = Particles.traits.FxParticles -> GameState {
    config { running: true }
  }

  trait RoundGate = Gate.traits.ObjectiveFlow -> GameState {
    config { running: true }
  }

  trait HeroIntent -> GameState [interaction, instance] {
    initial: playing

    state playing {
      INIT -> playing
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: (array/concat [ { label: @config.scoreLabel, value: @entity.score }, { label: @config.objectiveLabel, value: @entity.objectivesLeft }, { label: "Moves", value: @entity.movesLeft }, { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] @config.extraStats) }
          addons: { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: sm, children: [ { type: button, action: CANCEL, label: "Cancel", variant: secondary }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Restart", variant: secondary } ] }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, align: center, children: [ { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Play Again", variant: primary } ] } null)
          children: [ { type: canvas, mode: "3d", camera: { mode: @config.cameraMode, zoom: @config.scale }, tileClickEvent: TILE_CLICK, unitClickEvent: UNIT_CLICK, unitScale: @config.unitScale, backgroundColor: @config.bgColor, children: [
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/filter (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t modelUrl) url) (object/get @t modelUrl) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))) })) (fn s (object/get (object/get @s asset) url))) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f assetUrl) })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.validMoves (fn m { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @m x), y: (object/get @m z) }, fill: "rgba(74,222,128,0.4)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (== (object/get @u id) @entity.selectedUnitId))) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "ellipse", position: (object/get @u position), radiusX: 0.5, radiusY: 0.2, stroke: "rgba(0,200,255,0.8)", strokeWidth: 3 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @u position), asset: (object/get @u modelUrl), id: (object/get @u id), width: 0.8, height: 0.8, anchor: "ground" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.8 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets }
          ] } ]
        })

      UNIT_CLICK -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id ?unitId))) team) "player"))
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId ?unitId)
        (set @entity.phase "selection")
        (set @entity.validMoves (array/map (array/filter @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t passable) true) (and (<= (grid/manhattan-distance (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id ?unitId))) position) { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }) @config.movementRange) (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (and (== (object/get (object/get @u position) x) (object/get @t x)) (== (object/get (object/get @u position) y) (object/get @t y)))))) 0))))) (fn t { x: (object/get @t x), z: (object/get @t y) })))

      TILE_CLICK -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (and (!= @entity.selectedUnitId "") (and (grid/in-bounds { x: ?x, y: ?z } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (and (<= (grid/manhattan-distance (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id @entity.selectedUnitId))) position) { x: ?x, y: ?z }) @config.movementRange) (and (== (object/get (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) ?x) (== (object/get @t y) ?z)))) passable) true) (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (and (== (object/get (object/get @u position) x) ?x) (== (object/get (object/get @u position) y) ?z))))) 0))))))
        (emit MOVE { unitId: @entity.selectedUnitId, x: ?x, y: ?z })
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")

      CANCEL -> playing when (!= @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")

      PLAY_AGAIN -> playing
        (emit RESTART { id: "board" })
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")
    }

    ticks {
      renderTick every 100ms
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: (array/concat [ { label: @config.scoreLabel, value: @entity.score }, { label: @config.objectiveLabel, value: @entity.objectivesLeft }, { label: "Moves", value: @entity.movesLeft }, { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] @config.extraStats) }
          addons: { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: sm, children: [ { type: button, action: CANCEL, label: "Cancel", variant: secondary }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Restart", variant: secondary } ] }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, align: center, children: [ { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Play Again", variant: primary } ] } null)
          children: [ { type: canvas, mode: "3d", camera: { mode: @config.cameraMode, zoom: @config.scale }, tileClickEvent: TILE_CLICK, unitClickEvent: UNIT_CLICK, unitScale: @config.unitScale, backgroundColor: @config.bgColor, children: [
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/filter (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t modelUrl) url) (object/get @t modelUrl) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))) })) (fn s (object/get (object/get @s asset) url))) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f assetUrl) })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.validMoves (fn m { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @m x), y: (object/get @m z) }, fill: "rgba(74,222,128,0.4)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (== (object/get @u id) @entity.selectedUnitId))) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "ellipse", position: (object/get @u position), radiusX: 0.5, radiusY: 0.2, stroke: "rgba(0,200,255,0.8)", strokeWidth: 3 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @u position), asset: (object/get @u modelUrl), id: (object/get @u id), width: 0.8, height: 0.8, anchor: "ground" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.8 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets }
          ] } ]
        })

      wanderTick every 900ms when (== @entity.result "none")
        (emit WANDER { tick: 1 })
    }

    emits {
      MOVE -> external {
        unitId : string!
        x : number!
        y : number!
      }
        @description "Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority"
        @tier "domain"
      WANDER -> external {
        tick : number!
      }
        @description "Advances neutral NPCs one random step via the hero-nav authority"
        @tier "domain"
      RESTART -> external {
        id : string!
      }
        @description "Resets every mechanic (units/budget, objectives, result) for a new round"
        @tier "domain"
      TILE_CLICK -> external {
        x : number!
        z : number!
        tileId : string
      }
        @description "tileClickEvent prop"
        @tier "domain"
      UNIT_CLICK -> external {
        unitId : string!
        x : number
        z : number
      }
        @description "unitClickEvent prop"
        @tier "domain"
      CANCEL -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Clears the current selection"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      gridWidth : number = 12
        @label "Grid Width"
        @description "Grid column count (matches HeroAuthority.gridWidth)."
        @tier "presentation"
      gridHeight : number = 12
        @label "Grid Height"
        @description "Grid row count (matches HeroAuthority.gridHeight)."
        @tier "presentation"
      movementRange : number = 1
        @label "Movement Range"
        @description "Max manhattan distance the hero may step per move."
        @tier "domain"
      scoreLabel : string = "Score"
        @label "Score Label"
        @description "HUD label for the score/progress counter (e.g. Deliveries counting up)."
        @tier "presentation"
      objectiveLabel : string = "Objectives Left"
        @label "Objective Label"
        @description "HUD label for the remaining-objective counter."
        @tier "presentation"
      extraStats : [HudStat] = []
        @label "Extra Stats"
        @description "Board-specific HUD stats appended after the standard set."
        @tier "presentation"
      cameraMode : string = "top-down"
        @label "Camera Mode"
        @description "3D canvas camera mode."
        @tier "presentation"
      scale : number = 0.45
        @label "Scale"
        @description "Canvas render scale."
        @tier "presentation"
      unitScale : number = 1
        @label "Unit Scale"
        @description "Unit draw-size multiplier."
        @tier "presentation"
      bgColor : string = "#0a0f1a"
        @label "Bg Color"
        @description "Canvas background color."
        @tier "presentation"
      fxPresets : [FxPreset] = [ { type: "pickup", color: "#ffe066", color2: "#ffffff", size: 0.5, shape: "spark", count: 6, glow: 0.14, vy: -0.3 } ]
        @label "Fx Presets"
        @description "This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark."
        @tier "presentation"
      assetManifest : AssetManifest = { terrains: {}, units: {}, features: {}, effects: {} }
        @label "Asset Manifest"
        @description "Per-role model manifest resolving tile/unit/feature models by terrain/category key."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/objective-board-3d" as ObjectiveBoard3DPage -> HeroAuthority, Collector, FxDecay, RoundGate, HeroIntent
}
